title: Align Tree Action Buttons to Value Column Right Edge
description: In the sketchpad details panel, TreeSection and TreeItem add/remove action buttons (AddIcon/RemoveIcon) need to sit flush with the right edge of the property value field column (160px wide). Currently they are placed inside the label content area of TreeAlignedRow and drift/misalign across nested groups. The fix should be generic for all collection nodes in the right-side property inspector.
summary: Replaced detail-panel value-edge alignment with shared layout rules in elements/ui: property controls now right-anchor fit-content widgets, and tree action rails use a reusable right-edge grid without fixed per-section widths. Extended existing render tests to cover toggle/button anchoring and tree action alignment; elements/ui tests and lint pass.
